rows.label: qst630204_msg0001
rows.name: This is a limited-time hat shop, mo.

rows.label: qst630204_msg0002
rows.name:
We carry all kinds of mushroom hats
that are very popular with Nopon, mo.

rows.label: qst630204_msg0003
rows.name:
We also have a few hats for Invidians
and Superbrians, mo.

rows.label: qst630204_msg0004
rows.name: Please have a look, mo.

rows.label: qst630204_msg0005
rows.name:
Mo-mo? Are you looking for a stylish
hat, mo?

rows.label: qst630204_msg0006
rows.name:
A scary woman threatened Hattotto
earlier too, mo...

rows.label: qst630204_msg0007
rows.name:
There was something I was too scared
to tell her, mo.

rows.label: qst630204_msg0008
rows.name:
Hattotto actually makes custom hats
too, mo.

rows.label: qst630204_msg0009
rows.name:
If you tell me what kind of hat you
want, I'll figure out what materials
are needed, mo.

rows.label: qst630204_msg0010
rows.name:
And if you bring them, I'll make it
for you, mo.

rows.label: qst630204_msg0101
rows.name: You want a custom-made hat, mo?

rows.label: qst630204_msg0102
rows.name: Then tell me what kind you want, mo.

rows.label: qst630204_msg0103
rows.name: Mo-mo!?

rows.label: qst630204_msg0104
rows.name:
Something that goes with an Invidian
woman's white clothes...

rows.label: qst630204_msg0105
rows.name: And simple, but elegant...

rows.label: qst630204_msg0106
rows.name:
With expensive-looking ornamentation
and a luxurious feel, mo!?

rows.label: qst630204_msg0107
rows.name:
That's quite an unreasonable request,
mo...

rows.label: qst630204_msg0108
rows.name:
Please wait a bit. I'll think about
it, mo.

rows.label: qst630204_msg0109
rows.name: I think I can make it work, mo!

rows.label: qst630204_msg0110
rows.name:
I'll tell you the materials I need, so
bring them to me, mo.

rows.label: qst630204_msg0111
rows.name: Three Sun-Dappled Curtains.

rows.label: qst630204_msg0113
rows.name: Six Crystal Camellias.

rows.label: qst630204_msg0114
rows.name: And six Maple Pieces.

rows.label: qst630204_msg0115
rows.name: And four Rainbow Parfaits.

rows.label: qst630204_msg0116
rows.name:
If you bring all of that, I can make
it, mo.

rows.label: qst630204_msg0117
rows.name:
It'll be hard, but do your best
gathering them, mo.

rows.label: qst630204_msg0118
rows.name:
I'm sure the reward will be worth it,
mooo.

rows.label: qst630204_msg0201
rows.name:
If you bring all of that, I can make
the custom hat, mo.
渡す

rows.label: qst630204_msg0301
rows.name:
Mo-mo!? You really managed to gather
so many valuable things, mo.

rows.label: qst630204_msg0302
rows.name: Amazing, mo. I'm impressed, mooo.

rows.label: qst630204_msg0303
rows.name:
All right, I'll start making it.
Please wait a little, mo.

rows.label: qst630204_msg0304
rows.name: It's finished, mo!

rows.label: qst630204_msg0305
rows.name:
It looks great on an Invidian woman in
white...

rows.label: qst630204_msg0306
rows.name: It's simple but elegant...

rows.label: qst630204_msg0307
rows.name:
And it has expensive-looking
ornamentation and a luxurious feel,
mo!

rows.label: qst630204_msg0308
rows.name: Hattotto is proud of this one, mo.

rows.label: qst630204_msg0309
rows.name:
By the way, I made it while eating
Rainbow Parfait, mo. It was delicious,
mooo.

rows.label: qst630204_msg0310
rows.name: Now, hurry and give it to her, mo.

rows.label: qst630204_msg0401
rows.name:
You should hurry and give her
Hattotto's masterpiece, mo.
